niah_evaluation.note: Only NIAH-3 at 8K was run, not the complete RULER suite. Earlier no-template NIAH artifacts are superseded and must not be used for cross-family conclusions.

prolong_8x8k.note: Absolute perplexity on unformatted raw text is unusually high; prefer the paired loss delta.

two_level_lod_niah_single_3_8k.description: Flat two-level LOD opens all exact pages in each routed region; coarse state size and open-count are unchanged.

no_chat_template_niah_single_3_8k.description: Matched native/recursive-LOD ablation with apply_chat_template disabled; all other evaluation and LOD settings match the primary Qwen3 pair.

two_level_lod_niah_single_3_8k.description: Flat two-level LOD opens all exact pages in each routed region; coarse state size and open-count are unchanged.

rope_nope_layer_ablation_niah_single_3_8.interpretation: The nine NoPE layers are much more LOD-sensitive than nine nearby RoPE layers, while the 27-layer RoPE result also demonstrates severe accumulation across many dense layers. The subset effects are nonlinear and should not be added as an independent causal decomposition.

padding_and_batch_size_ablation_niah_sin.interpretation: Batch size 1 removes cross-example left padding but improves LOD by only one example and full attention by three. Physically stripping padding at batch size 8 scores below chunk-aligned padding. Left-padding handling does not explain the SmolLM3 LOD regression.

qwen25.reason: The current fused route kernel does not support Qwen2.5's non-power-of-two GQA ratio of 12 query heads to 2 KV heads. No LOD score is reported.

superseded_results.reason: The earlier generic-HF NIAH runs omitted lm-eval's chat template and mixed a base/hybrid Qwen control with instruction-tuned checkpoints.

conclusions: Chat formatting completely eliminates the apparent Gemma4 NIAH regression: corrected full and LOD both score 64/64.
Dense instruction-tuned Qwen3 remains strong when all 28 attention layers use LOD, scoring 60/64 versus 64/64 full attention.
Without chat templating, Qwen3 full attention and recursive LOD both score 62/64; their paired outcomes are not identical, with two full-only and two LOD-only examples.
Gemma3 and SmolLM3 still show material paired retrieval regressions after the formatting correction, scoring 47/64 and 43/64 under recursive LOD versus 61/64 full attention.
Flat two-level LOD leaves Qwen3 unchanged at 60/64 and improves SmolLM3 from 43/64 to 50/64, but SmolLM3 remains below its 61/64 full-attention score.

On SmolLM3, replacing only the nine NoPE layers scores 48/64 while replacing nine depth-matched RoPE layers scores 64/64; all 16 discordant examples favor the RoPE subset, supporting special NoPE-layer sensitivity.

Replacing all 27 RoPE layers scores only 8/64, showing that error accumulation across many dense layers is independently severe; the nonlinearity relative to the 43/64 all-36-layer result means subset drops are not additive.

SmolLM3 padding controls rule out batch padding as the regression source: batch-size-1 full/LOD score 64/44, versus 61/43 at batch size 8, and exact physical padding removal at batch size 8 scores 39 under LOD.
The corrected evidence supports model-family sensitivity, but the strongest earlier claim about Gemma4 and the original base/hybrid Qwen comparison was an evaluation artifact.
ProLong remains a weak predictor of exact retrieval: Qwen3 and SmolLM3 both have about a 0.65% perplexity increase, while their NIAH drops are 4 and 18 net examples.
